title: Align MJCF finger actuator torque limits with URDF and USD
body:
The MJCF finger position actuators currently have no actuator torque
limits, while the corresponding URDF joints specify effort limits and
the USD physics configuration specifies matching drive maxForce values.

This allows the MJCF actuators to produce torques above the limits
defined in the other model formats. In a controlled simulation, the
right index DIP sustained approximately 0.3 N·m under an opposing load,
exceeding its URDF/USD limit of 0.189369 N·m.

### Changes

- Add symmetric joint-level actuatorfrcrange limits to the five finger
  joint classes across all 15 MJCF variants.
- Derive the limits from each corresponding URDF's effort values.
- Document the torque limits and add regression tests.

The changes preserve controller gains, damping, inertia, geometry,
joint ranges, and virtual-base force limits.

### Validation

Tested with MuJoCo 3.14.0:

- Verified positive and negative torque saturation across all variants.
- Verified unchanged trajectories for an unsaturated small movement.
- Verified the expected response under a sustained opposing load.
- Ran short stability checks for all variants without numerical warnings.
- Regression tests and git diff --check pass.

Test command:
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v

### Scope and assumptions

This change aligns the MJCF models with the limits already defined in
the repository. It does not independently validate hardware torque
ratings or full object-grasping behavior.

The symmetric limits follow the single effort magnitude provided by
URDF. Please confirm that these URDF/USD limits are also intended for
the MJCF position-control models.

The existing dual-hand mesh path issue is outside this PR's scope;
tests resolve those path problems shown in PR#1

title: update mesh path so dual hand setup can be correctly loaded
body:
I can't seem to load the dual-hand XML in MuJoCo, whether by dropping it to the viewer or loading it using MuJoCo's XML parsing API. 

The error message shows 
```
mjw.put_model(mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path('[redacted]/sharpa-urdf-usd-xml/wave_01/dual_sharpa_wave/dual_sharpa_wave_with_wrist.xml'))

ValueError: Error: Error opening file 'left_sharpa_wave/meshes/left_thumb_CMC_VL.STL'
```

It seems like it's trying to find the mesh in the current folder, but left_sharpa_wave is actually a sibling folder to the dual-hand setup.

Simply adding `../` would allow the XML to find the correct mesh. Please let me know if I miss anything
